info.name: SmartPark - Sprint 2 Designed APIs Test Suite
info.description:
Bộ test Postman chuyên sâu kiểm thử toàn bộ 7 API Specifications do Nguyễn Duy Khánh thiết kế trong Sprint 2:
1. SPARK-174/175: Driver Register & OTP Verification
2. SPARK-175: Owner Register & Email Verification
3. SPARK-194: Admin Approve Owner Account
4. SPARK-205: Admin Manage Users (Search, Lock, Unlock, Pagination)
5. SPARK-190: Owner Create Operator Account & Password Bootstrap
6. SPARK-226: Vehicle Registration & Canonical Plate Normalization
7. SPARK-187: Parking Structure Management (Lots, Units, Slots, Paths, Backup, Operations)

Bao gồm Happy Path, Negative cases, Boundary checks, Schema validation và Authorization checks.
